entities.name: Karla Erbová
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Karla Erbová was a Czech contemporary poet, prose writer, and journalist. Many of her writings are historical or mythological in subject matter, often including works on Ancient Greece. Born on 30 April 1933, Erbová died on 19 March 2024, at the age of 90.
